name: wiz3D — OpenGL Quad-Buffer Stereo Handler
description: wiz3D component (effcol) for OpenGL games that natively support quad-buffer stereoscopic rendering. wiz3D provides a surface for the game to render its left/right buffers onto, then re-outputs to any supported display format. Same capture-and-reroute trick as the 3D Vision Direct Mode and HD3D variants, but for the OpenGL pipeline. Absorbs what would otherwise be a standalone 'OpenGL Quad-Buffer Stereo' tool — wiz3D's wiz3D/opengl-quad-buffer-stereo/ variant IS that pipeline. Config via wiz3D_Config.xml.
license: LGPL-2.1 (not bundled — fetched at setup from upstream releases)

latest.notes: Shares the wide output catalogue of the DX wrapper variant (vintage HMDs, passive 3D displays, shutter variants). Games select this variant when they natively support OpenGL quad-buffer stereo and want a modern display route.
